proposalRationale:
TJR target selection: targets are the previous draws on liquidity in the trade direction.

CLASSIFICATION: SOURCE-STATED but DEFINITIONALLY DEPENDENT. 3 supporting evidence items, 0
contradicting -- the best-supported target statement in the TJR corpus. It is nonetheless not
independently computable, because it is stated entirely in terms of "draw on liquidity", whose
enumeration lives in a separate claim (CLAIM|TJR|20260727|009: 1-hour highs/lows, 4-hour
highs/lows, or session highs/lows) and whose eligibility filter lives in another
(CLAIM|TJR|20260727|011).

MECHANICAL SPECIFICATION: build the candidate draw set as the 1H, 4H and session highs and lows
per |009, located by the wick rule per |065; filter out any level already swept without producing
a reaction per |011; then take, in trade direction, the ordered sequence of surviving levels
beyond entry as the take-profit ladder, consistent with partial-taking across multiple levels
(CLAIM|TJR|20260727|030).

DATA REQUIRED: 1H, 4H and session-aggregated OHLC series over a stated lookback, plus prior price
history sufficient to evaluate the |011 already-swept filter.

FALSIFICATION: for a charted TJR trade, compute the surviving draw set and compare against his
actual marked targets. If his targets are levels absent from the computed set, or if he skips
surviving nearer levels without a stated reason, the mechanical form is refuted even though the
verbal claim stands.

BLOCKING UNKNOWNS, both inherited: (a) LOOKBACK is unstated -- |009 says 1H/4H/session highs and
lows but never says how far back levels remain eligible. Without a lookback the candidate draw set
is unbounded and the rule computes nothing. (b) "REACTION" in |011 is undefined -- the filter that
decides which levels survive has no mechanical form anywhere in the corpus; no threshold, no
timeframe, no displacement measure. Both are recorded as gaps. Note that (b) is a genuine
circularity risk for any implementation: "reaction" is the same notion the strategy's own
confirmation step is trying to detect, so defining it here without source support would silently
invent the core of the strategy.

FURTHER UNKNOWN: partial sizing per level is unstated -- |030 says profits are taken in partials
across multiple take-profit levels, but not what fraction is closed at each.
